notes: Curated Phase 1 race library for RaceIQ. Each entry drives one real FastF1 generation via scripts/generate_batch.py (which calls the existing scripts/generate_analysis.py -> analysis/raceiq/ engine for every entry).

"event" is the lookup string passed to FastF1 (fastf1.get_event(year, event)), not a guaranteed-exact FastF1 EventName -- FastF1 resolves it with its own fuzzy match against that season's schedule. scripts/generate_batch.py resolves and prints the official name/round for every entry before generating, and skips (does not crash) an entry that fails to resolve.

"description" must stay a neutral, publicly documented historical fact about the event itself (date, location, championship/season context, a widely reported on-track result), never a RaceIQ-derived analytical claim (pace, consistency, degradation) -- those only belong here once this repository has actually generated and reviewed that race's real data. See docs/DECISIONS.md.

races.description: Held at Hockenheimring in wet conditions; Sebastian Vettel crashed out of the lead in the closing laps and Lewis Hamilton won after starting 14th on the grid.
A night race on the Marina Bay Street Circuit.
Held at Interlagos in Sao Paulo, Brazil.
The final round of the 2018 season, held at Yas Marina Circuit.
Held at Hockenheimring in wet and changeable conditions.
Held at Interlagos; a penultimate-lap collision between Lewis Hamilton and Alexander Albon while fighting for position drew a post-race penalty for Hamilton. Max Verstappen won the race.
Held at Monza, one of the highest average-speed circuits on the Formula 1 calendar.
Held on the Baku City Circuit street track.
A one-off 2020 event on the Bahrain International Circuit's outer layout. Sergio Perez fell to the back of the field after a first-lap incident and recovered to win, his first Formula 1 victory.
Held at Istanbul Park in wet, low-grip conditions. Lewis Hamilton won from sixth on the grid to secure his seventh World Drivers' Championship, equaling Michael Schumacher's record at the time.
Held at Monza. Pierre Gasly won his first Grand Prix for AlphaTauri (formerly Toro Rosso), the team's first win since 2008.
The 2021 season finale at Yas Marina Circuit, where the Drivers' Championship was decided between Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton on the final lap.
Held at Silverstone; a first-lap collision between Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton at Copse corner ended Verstappen's race. Hamilton received a time penalty and went on to win.
The inaugural Formula 1 race on the Jeddah Corniche Circuit, held at night.
Held at Suzuka and shortened by a red flag in wet conditions. Max Verstappen's win secured his second World Drivers' Championship.
Held on the Jeddah Corniche Circuit. Max Verstappen and Charles Leclerc traded the lead in the closing laps before Verstappen won by roughly half a second.
The inaugural Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix, a Saturday night street race on the Las Vegas Strip.
Held at Circuit Zandvoort, Max Verstappen's home race. Verstappen won from pole in a rain-affected race that was red-flagged late for heavy rain.
Held on the Marina Bay Street Circuit. Carlos Sainz's win for Ferrari ended Red Bull's run of consecutive victories that season.
Held on the Circuit de Monaco street track. RaceIQ's first committed real analysis was generated from this race.
